user.title: Akce na pivo
user.description: Name the integration and pick a country. Czechia uses Czech deal sites (CZK), Slovakia uses Slovak ones (EUR). Add the integration twice for both.

settings.title: Akce na pivo – {country}
settings.description: Pick beer brands (or type your own and press Enter), deal sites, where to measure distance from and when to check the deals. Stores are looked up in OpenStreetMap within {country} only.

data.custom_urls: Custom deal page URLs (one per line)
data.location_entity: Location (person / device tracker / zone) – empty = HA home
data.update_interval_hours: Additionally check every N hours (0 = daily only)
data.top_count: How many cheapest offers to show
data.require_nearby_store: Only show shops with a branch nearby
data.price_alert: Alert when 0.5 l costs less than

data_description.custom_urls: Optional. The URL may contain the placeholder query (searched brand) or slug (brand like pilsner-urquell) wrapped in curly braces – see the README for examples.
data_description.packaging: Packaging is detected from the deal name (can, bottle, glass, PET…). Beer of 1 l or more is treated as PET.
data_description.include_unknown_packaging: Flyers often omit the packaging. Turn off to show only deals where it is stated.
data_description.degrees: Detected from the deal name (Kozel 11, 12°, 12%…). Well-known beers without a number are filled in, e.g. Pilsner Urquell = 12°.
data_description.include_unknown_degree: When off, only deals with a known degree are shown.

error.no_brands: Select or enter at least one brand.
